## Summary
Implement the final P2 step that checks whether >100 new SubConcepts have been confirmed since the last GNN retrain and conditionally emits `journey/gnn.retrain-trigger`, plus a weekly reconciliation cron job that re-syncs failed Neo4j writes from all P2 steps.

## User story
As a platform engineer, I want the GNN retrain triggered automatically when enough new data accumulates, and failed Neo4j writes automatically retried weekly, so that the knowledge graph stays accurate without manual intervention.

## Why this matters
Without the GNN retrain trigger, the recommendation model becomes stale as new SubConcepts are added — students get suboptimal practice item selection. Without weekly reconciliation, Neo4j drift accumulates silently: Supabase has data that Neo4j doesn't, causing inconsistent graph queries that affect assessment generation and coverage reporting.

## Acceptance criteria
### GNN retrain check (Step 07)
- [ ] Count SubConcepts confirmed since last GNN retrain timestamp
- [ ] If count > 100, emit `journey/gnn.retrain-trigger` event with `{ count, institution_id, since }`
- [ ] If count <= 100, log count and skip (no event emitted)
- [ ] Last retrain timestamp read from Supabase `system_config` table
- [ ] Step returns: `{ confirmed_since_last_retrain: number, retrain_triggered: boolean }`

### Weekly reconciliation cron
- [ ] Inngest cron function `journey/sync.reconcile` runs Monday 1am
- [ ] Queries Supabase for rows where `neo4j_sync_status = 'failed'` across all P2-related tables
- [ ] Re-attempts Neo4j writes for each failed row using neo4jQuery (Rule 1)
- [ ] Updates `neo4j_sync_status` to 'synced' on success, increments retry_count on failure
- [ ] Uses Promise.allSettled for batch re-sync (Rule 3)
- [ ] Logs reconciliation summary: `{ total_failed, retried, succeeded, still_failed }`

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for all reconciliation Neo4j writes |
| Rule 3 | Promise.allSettled for batch reconciliation retries — never Promise.all |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Reconciliation confirms Supabase is source of truth; Neo4j is eventual |

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// Pattern: GNN retrain check with conditional event emission
import { inngest } from '../../client';
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server';

export async function gnnRetrainCheck(
  institution_id: string,
  step: InngestStep
) {
  const supabase = createServerClient();

  // 1. Get last retrain timestamp
  const { data: config } = await supabase
    .from('system_config')
    .select('value')
    .eq('key', 'last_gnn_retrain')
    .single();

  const since = config?.value?.timestamp ?? '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z';

  // 2. Count confirmed SubConcepts since last retrain
  const { count } = await supabase
    .from('subconcepts')
    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
    .eq('institution_id', institution_id)
    .eq('status', 'confirmed')
    .gt('confirmed_at', since);

  // 3. Conditionally emit retrain trigger
  if (count > 100) {
    await step.sendEvent('journey/gnn.retrain-trigger', {
      data: { count, institution_id, since },
    });
  }

  return { confirmed_since_last_retrain: count, retrain_triggered: count > 100 };
}

// Pattern: Weekly reconciliation cron with Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client';

export const cronSyncReconcile = inngest.createFunction(
  { id: 'journey/sync.reconcile' },
  { cron: '0 1 * * 1' }, // Monday 1am
  async ({ step }) => {
    const supabase = createServerClient();

    // 1. Find all failed sync rows
    const { data: failed } = await supabase
      .from('subconcepts')
      .select('id, institution_id')
      .eq('neo4j_sync_status', 'failed');

    // 2. Retry with Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      failed.map(row => retryNeo4jSync(row.id, row.institution_id))
    );

    // 3. Update statuses
    const succeeded = results.filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
    const stillFailed = results.filter(r => r.status === 'rejected').length;

    return { total_failed: failed.length, retried: failed.length, succeeded, still_failed: stillFailed };
  }
);
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. Supabase: `DELETE FROM system_config WHERE key = 'last_gnn_retrain'` (if newly created)
2. No Neo4j cleanup needed — GNN check only reads, reconciliation only re-creates
3. Remove apps/inngest/functions/cron-sync-reconcile.ts
4. Remove apps/inngest/functions/p2-steps/gnn-retrain-check.ts
5. Remove cron registration from apps/inngest/functions/index.ts
6. git stash && git checkout develop
